title: Registrar Review and Graduation Eligibility Certification & Degree Clearance

seedSql.query: DELETE FROM stu.graduation_records WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a67648610008'

INSERT INTO stu.lifecycle_status (tenant_id, student_id, status, effective_from, updated_at) VALUES ('a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a67648610008', 'ACTIVE', now() - interval '365 days', now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, student_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = now()

steps.title: Portal Authentication
steps.description: College Administrator / Registrar authenticates to CampXSync with authorized R31 staff session

steps.title: Navigate to Lifecycle Review Desk
steps.description: Verify College Lifecycle workspace loads with institutional review authority

steps.title: Input Student Record ID
steps.description: Registrar inputs candidate student record identifier for degree audit

steps.title: Input Programme ID
steps.description: Registrar inputs candidate degree programme identifier (B.Tech CSE)

steps.title: Input Official Graduation Date
steps.description: Registrar sets formal convocation and degree conferral date

steps.title: Execute Eligibility Pre-Validation
steps.description: Dispatch POST /api/v1/lifecycle/graduation/validate through Gateway to check standing and pending petitions

steps.title: Assert Eligibility Success Confirmation
steps.description: System displays green confirmation confirming student meets all graduation standing criteria

steps.title: Record Irreversible Graduation Certification
steps.description: Registrar executes formal degree clearance, dispatching POST /api/v1/lifecycle/graduation/record

steps.title: Verify Graduation Certification Notification
steps.description: System displays green success notification confirming degree conferral and status transition to GRADUATED

steps.title: PostgreSQL Graduation Records Committed Check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.graduation_records contains committed degree certification record
steps.query: SELECT id, student_id, program_id, graduated_on FROM stu.graduation_records WHERE student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a67648610008' AND program_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000040'

steps.title: PostgreSQL Student Status Transition Committed Check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.lifecycle_status transitioned student standing from ACTIVE to GRADUATED
steps.query: SELECT student_id, status FROM stu.lifecycle_status WHERE student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a67648610008' AND status = 'GRADUATED'

steps.title: PostgreSQL Lifecycle Audit History Committed Check
steps.description: Read-only query verifies stu.lifecycle_history appended graduation transition entry
steps.query: SELECT student_id, status, action FROM stu.lifecycle_history WHERE student_id = '81dd67d3-1d5f-4d8e-8061-a67648610008' AND status = 'GRADUATED' AND action = 'graduation.recorded'

steps.title: Negative RBAC Enforcement Check
steps.description: Unauthenticated POST request to gateway graduation endpoints must fail closed with HTTP 401/403
